ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1979
DELIMITATION OF CONSTITUENCIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance to amend the Delimination of Constituencies Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 19th June, 1979]
No. F. 17(1)/79 Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information
1. Short title, application and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance
may be called the Delimitation of Constituencies (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It applies only in respect of
the forthcoming elections.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1979
DELIMITATION OF CONSTITUENCIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance to amend the Delimination of Constituencies Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 19th June, 1979]
No. F. 17(1)/79 Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information
2. Amendment of section 5, Act XXXIV of 1974. -In the Delimitation
of Constituencies Act, 1974 (XXXIV of 1974), for section 5 the following shall
be substituted, namely :-
"5. Delegation of powers; etc. -(1) Notwithstanding anything
contained in section 4, the Commission may authorise one or more of its
members, acting singly or together, to exercise and perform all or any of its
powers and functions under this Act.
(2) Where two or more members are
authorised under subsection (1),-
(a) their decision shall be
expressed in terms of the opinion of the majority ; or
(b) if they are equally divided,
the matter shall be placed for decision before the Commission."
